hero.title: Your cluster, ready when you are.
hero.description: Open the apps you need, review cluster health, adjust your preferences, and jump to the right place without hunting for hostnames.

userAdmin.title: Gebruikers en groepen
userAdmin.description: Voeg gebruikers toe, zet accounts uit, en koppel mensen aan vooraf goedgekeurde groepen zonder in de volledige Authentik-beheeromgeving te hoeven werken.
userAdmin.emptyStateDescription: Voeg in config/portal/content.json expliciet de zakelijke groepen toe die deze eenvoudige beheerpagina mag tonen en beheren.

observability.title: Observability control
observability.description: Choose how much monitoring the cluster should carry. Small clusters can switch to a stripped-down profile while bigger clusters can keep the full stack.
observability.footnote: Metrics-server stays enabled in every mode so kubectl top and basic capacity checks continue to work.

minimal.description: Keep metrics, drop the logs/traces/dashboard stack, and run Prometheus with short retention and no Longhorn-backed observability PVCs.
impact: Prometheus stays on in a lightweight form
Grafana, Loki, Tempo, and Alloy are removed
Monitoring churn drops sharply on small hardware
removes: Kubernetes log and event shipping via Alloy
minimal.warning: This profile is tuned for small clusters and trades history depth for lower churn.

full.description: Keep Prometheus, Alertmanager, Loki, Tempo, Alloy, and Grafana active for the richest operator experience.
impact: Prometheus, Alertmanager, Loki, Tempo, Alloy, and Grafana are active
Dashboards, logs, traces, and alerts stay available
Best for larger clusters or active debugging
full.warning: This is the most capable and the heaviest mode.

off.description: Remove the observability apps and leave only the small baseline cluster utilities.
impact: Grafana, Loki, Tempo, and Alloy are removed
off.warning: Use this only when you want the stack fully gone, not merely trimmed.
